_comment: Style library: katana (HEROES_V2.md 13.6). G3 builds the ready stance and the first cut of the string; G5 completes the library (attack.2-3, draw, sheathe, guard, dodge, intro, victory, taunt).

combat.idle.description: Ready stance, breathing twice as fast as the idle.

attack.1.description: A one-handed diagonal cut from over the right shoulder: the wind-up eases out to 0.20 s and stretches to 0.30 s, the cut accelerates through two ticks and lands at 0.40 s (the 'hit' marker), follow-through to 0.55 s, back on the ready stance at 0.90 s. Upper body only, so the legs keep walking under it.
